This represents a Smart Altruistic Maneuver. The author seeks to correct a self-destructive loop within their own coalition by promoting transparency and empathy toward Muslim partners, defusing the manufactured division that extremists exploit.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Good. Self-correction and alignment with shared human values build durable peace.

The Unavoidable Lie: You can build a lasting regional alliance while demonizing the population of your allies.

Strategic wisdom and moral integrity converge here. A coalition built on shared interests cannot survive when fueled by domestic contempt for the partner's identity.
